name: Status effect
description: Descriptive conditions that may affect a character or creature

fields.name: Bruised
fields.description: minor pain causes -1 on the next demanding physical action.

fields.name: Fatigued
fields.description: prolonged effort and travel are more difficult until resting.

fields.name: Shaken
fields.description: -1 against the next fear or intimidation effect.

fields.name: Bleeding
fields.description: loses a small amount of HP after strenuous actions until treated.

fields.name: Burning
fields.description: takes recurring fire damage until the flames are extinguished.

fields.name: Chilled
fields.description: movement and Speed-based actions are reduced until warmed.

fields.name: Dazed
fields.description: reactions cost additional effort during the next turn.

fields.name: Blinded
fields.description: sight-based actions fail or suffer a major penalty.

fields.name: Deafened
fields.description: cannot hear speech, warnings, or sound-based effects clearly.

fields.name: Poisoned
fields.description: Constitution-based resistance is required as the poison progresses.

fields.name: Slowed
fields.description: MD is reduced until the effect ends.

fields.name: Weakened
fields.description: Strength-based actions suffer a penalty.

fields.name: Confused
fields.description: has difficulty distinguishing allies, enemies, or directions.

fields.name: Frightened
fields.description: cannot willingly approach the source of fear without succeeding on a roll.

fields.name: Stunned
fields.description: temporarily loses the ability to take normal actions.

fields.name: Paralyzed
fields.description: voluntary movement is impossible until the condition is broken.

fields.name: Silenced
fields.description: speech and voice-dependent abilities cannot be used.

fields.name: Cursed
fields.description: a supernatural penalty persists until its specific condition is resolved.

fields.name: Petrification
fields.description: the body is slowly turning to stone and requires urgent intervention.

fields.name: Possessed
fields.description: An outside will occasionally contest control of the subject.

fields.name: Marked
fields.description: a magical sign allows a hostile creature or effect to track the subject.

fields.name: Invisible
fields.description: cannot be seen normally but still makes sound and leaves traces.

fields.name: Regenerating
fields.description: restores a small amount of HP at the end of each turn.

fields.name: Inspired
fields.description: may reroll one chosen die, after which this status ends.

fields.name: Distracted
fields.description: The subject loses track of their surroundings and is disadvantaged on the next action requiring sustained attention.

fields.name: Drunk
fields.description: Coordination and judgment are impaired until rest or suitable treatment.

fields.name: Intoxicated
fields.description: An unknown substance alters perception or reactions; the exact effect depends on the product.

fields.name: Feverish
fields.description: Illness drains the subject and makes prolonged effort more difficult.

fields.name: Meditative
fields.description: The subject is deeply focused; interruption ends the sought benefit and leaves brief disorientation.

fields.name: Prone
fields.description: The subject is lying on the ground, limiting movement and defense until they stand.

fields.name: Restrained
fields.description: Bindings, terrain, or another force severely limit the subject’s movement.

fields.name: Grappled
fields.description: Another creature holds the subject in place until the grip is escaped or broken.

fields.name: Unconscious
fields.description: The subject is unaware and cannot take deliberate actions until consciousness returns.

fields.name: Suffocating
fields.description: The subject cannot breathe adequately and requires air before the condition becomes life-threatening.

fields.name: Exhausted
fields.description: Severe weariness limits sustained activity until the subject receives substantial rest.

fields.name: Starving
fields.description: Prolonged lack of food weakens the subject and makes further exertion difficult.

fields.name: Dehydrated
fields.description: Prolonged lack of water causes weakness, dizziness, and increasing difficulty with exertion.
